column2: Rumours of gold on The Mountain have been confirmed. Prospectors and fortune-seekers are already streaming toward its slopes, and the world's markets will soon feel the weight of new coin.
A major gold strike near Klugetown has set off a rush across the desert. The town's markets are awash with new money.
Gold has been discovered in the hills around Flowena, drawing miners and merchants to the city.
A rich gold vein has been found near Firstport. The harbour is bracing for a flood of prospectors.
Prospectors have struck gold at New Ayacachtli. Word is spreading fast through the region.
A gold find at Bronzekreuz has sparked a rush, and the local economy is booming.
Gold has been discovered in the mines of Skyfall. Fortune-seekers are flocking to the city.
